concept: Kashida — the word appears stretched on its own kashida strokes and breathes in to its true proportions; diamond dots stamped last (RTL)
rationale: joined-stroke band y 325–398 and two joined runs (تسو, يق) with a non-joining break after و; dots p2/p4/p8 identical rhombi (qalam nib)

stages.name: kashida strokes RTL
stages.final_state: two kashida bars at band height y 330–380 in the elongated layout
stages.changes: k1 scaleX 0→1 from its right end (x 1130) over 0.6 s; k2 grows out of ي (right end x 220) at 0.86 s over 0.32 s

stages.name: letters open from band
stages.initial_state: letter bodies hidden by zero-height feathered masks at band centre y 355
stages.final_state: dotless rasm fully visible, elongated by 480 viewBox units
stages.changes: mask rect y 355→40, height 0→560, 0.7 s each, RTL stagger 0.13 s (+0.03 s at the و/ي break)

stages.name: breathe in (contraction)
stages.final_state: official spacing; kashida bars shortened into the joins and faded once covered
stages.changes: group x → 0; bar x/width → final [590,890], [240,300]; kashida opacity 1→0 at 2.05–2.20

stages.name: dot stamps RTL
stages.changes: opacity 0→1 in 0.04 s; scale 1.6→1 over 0.38 s (nib press); order ت, ي, ق at 0.12 s spacing
